drivingQuestion: May the Decalogue be recited daily outside the Temple as the priestly watch recited it?
outcomeNote: The abolition stands: both attempts to reinstate the daily Decalogue, in Sura and in Neharde'a, were blocked with the same answer.

segments.he: וְקוֹרִין עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדִּבְּרוֹת ״שְׁמַע״, ״וְהָיָה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ״, ״וַיֹּאמֶר״, ״אֱמֶת וְיַצִּיב״, וַעֲבוֹדָה, וּבִרְכַּת כֹּהֲנִים.
segments.en: The Gemara related above that the priests in the Temple «read the Ten Commandments,» along with the sections of «Shema, VeHaya im Shamoa, VaYomer, True and Firm, Avoda, and the priestly benediction.»

segments.he: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: אַף בִּגְבוּלִין בִּקְּשׁוּ לִקְרוֹת כֵּן, אֶלָּא שֶׁכְּבָר בִּטְּלוּם מִפְּנֵי תַּרְעוֹמֶת הַמִּינִין.
segments.en: «Rav Yehuda said» that «Shmuel said: Even in the outlying areas,» outside the Temple, «they sought to recite» the Ten Commandments «in this manner» every day, as they are the basis of the Torah (Rambam), «but they had already abolished» recitation of the Ten Commandments «due to the grievance of the heretics,» who argued that the entire Torah, with the exception of the Ten Commandments, did not emanate from God (Jerusalem Talmud). If the Ten Commandments were recited daily, that would lend credence to their claim, so their recitation was expunged from the daily prayers.

segments.he: תַּנְיָא נָמֵי הָכִי, רַבִּי נָתָן אוֹמֵר: בִּגְבוּלִין בִּקְּשׁוּ לִקְרוֹת כֵּן, אֶלָּא שֶׁכְּבָר בִּטְּלוּם מִפְּנֵי תַּרְעוֹמֶת הַמִּינִין.
segments.en: «That was also taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi Natan says: In the outlying areas, they sought to recite» the Ten Commandments «in this manner, but they had already abolished» their recitation «due to the grievance of the heretics.»

segments.he: רַבָּה בַּר בַּר חַנָּה סְבַר לְמִקְבְּעִינְהוּ בְּסוּרָא, אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב חִסְדָּא: כְּבָר בִּטְּלוּם מִפְּנֵי תַּרְעוֹמֶת הַמִּינִין.
segments.en: The Gemara relates that several Sages sought to reinstitute recitation of the Ten Commandments, as «Rabba bar bar Ḥana thought to institute this in» the city of «Sura,» but «Rav Ḥisda said to him: They already abolished them due to the grievance of the heretics.»

segments.he: אֲמֵימַר סְבַר לְמִקְבְּעִינְהוּ בִּנְהַרְדְּעָא, אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב אָשֵׁי: כְּבָר בִּטְּלוּם מִפְּנֵי תַּרְעוֹמֶת הַמִּינִין.
segments.en: So too, «Ameimar thought to institute this in» the city of «Neharde’a. Rav Ashi,» the most prominent of the Sages in that generation, «said to him: They already abolished them due to the grievance of the heretics.»
